notes.text: An independently identifiable sheet held up during the classroom activity to draw and write to Hoa Hakananaiʻa. The frontal figure stands between two trees, with RAPA NUI written across the upper part. This composition distinguishes it from the other sheets in the following museum montage. The person holding the drawing is not assumed to be its maker; the visible writing does not establish a reliable author identification. The title is editorial. The representation is an unretouched film still at 00:24:58, retaining the original frame composition.
